"""Certificate quality statistics over corpora."""
import glob
import json
import sys
import importlib.util

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("planner", "/app/submission/planner.py")
planner = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(planner)

files = sys.argv[1:]
import collections
ti = collections.Counter()
worst = {"pv": 0.0, "dv": 0.0, "gap": 0.0, "mig": 0.0}
n_infeasible = 0
n_opt = 0
n_dual_lp_needed = 0
for path in files:
    for line in open(path):
        line = line.strip()
        if not line:
            continue
        try:
            req = planner.validate(planner.parse_request(line))
        except planner.Invalid:
            continue
        prob = planner.build_problem(req)
        res = planner._safe_linprog(prob["c"], prob["A_ub"], prob["b_ub"],
                                    prob["A_eq"], prob["b_eq"], (0.0, None),
                                    "highs", {"presolve": True})
        if res is None:
            print("SOLVE ERROR", path)
            continue
        if res.status == 2:
            n_infeasible += 1
            cert = planner.witness_min_rho(prob)
            if cert is None:
                ti["minrho_none"] += 1
                continue
            nv, val = planner.norm_violation(prob, cert["y"], cert["q"])
            dv = planner.dual_violation_inf(prob, cert["y"], cert["q"])
            worst["gap"] = max(worst["gap"], nv)
            worst["dv"] = max(worst["dv"], dv)
            ti["minrho_t%d" % cert["tier"]] += 1
            continue
        if res.status != 0:
            ti["status%d" % res.status] += 1
            continue
        n_opt += 1
        primal = planner.make_primal(prob, res)
        worst["pv"] = max(worst["pv"], primal["pv"])
        worst["mig"] = max(worst["mig"], primal["pv"])
        dual = planner.dual_from_marginals(prob, res)
        cand = planner.optimal_response(prob, primal, dual)
        ti["marginals_t%d" % cand["tier"]] += 1
        if cand["tier"] < 2:
            n_dual_lp_needed += 1
            dual2 = planner.dual_by_lp(prob)
            cand2 = planner.optimal_response(prob, primal, dual2) if dual2 is not None else None
            ti["duallp_t%d" % (cand2["tier"] if cand2 else -1)] += 1
            if cand2 is not None and cand2["tier"] > cand["tier"]:
                cand = cand2
        # record worst values of the final candidate
        y = cand["response"]["dual"]["inequality"]
        q = cand["response"]["dual"]["equality"]
        import numpy as np
        yv = np.array(y); qv = np.array(q)
        dv = planner.dual_violation(prob, yv, qv)
        lval = float(prob["b_ub"] @ yv) + (float(prob["b_eq"] @ qv) if prob["b_eq"] is not None else 0.0)
        worst["dv"] = max(worst["dv"], dv)
        worst["gap"] = max(worst["gap"], abs(lval - primal["mlu"]) / 2e-5)

print("optimal:", n_opt, "infeasible:", n_infeasible)
print("tiers:", dict(ti))
print("worst (fractions of verifier tolerance):", worst)
print("dual LP fallback used:", n_dual_lp_needed)
PYEOF
